name: Assassination Plot
summary: Assassination Plot is a Horde quest initiated by recovering intercepted centaur orders in Thousand Needles. The orders reveal an impending strike targeting the tauren Kanati Greycloud at his hunting camp by Whitereach Post.

sections.title: A Hunter in Hostile Lands
sections.body: Thousand Needles has long been contested terrain dominated by warring centaur clans and dangerous wildlife. When the tauren brave Kanati Greycloud set up a hunting camp at Whitereach Post, the small post southwest of the Great Lift, the local centaur viewed it as an audacious intrusion into their territory. Rather than merely driving game away, the centaur resolved to eliminate Greycloud entirely to discourage any further Horde expansion through the canyon.

sections.title: The Intercepted Orders
sections.body: The plot comes to light when a traveler recovers a written decree outlining the centaur strategy. The note names Kanati Greycloud directly, castigating his boldness and commanding a strike force to converge upon Whitereach Post to wipe out the camp and anyone who might dare follow him. Delivering the missive to Kanati forewarns the hunter, prompting him to prepare for an immediate stand against the raiders.

faq.answer: It is a coordinated ambush planned by local centaur against Kanati Greycloud, a tauren who set up a hunting camp at Whitereach Post in Thousand Needles. The centaur want him dead to prevent the Horde from gaining a foothold in the canyon.

Kanati Greycloud is a tauren who has set up a hunting camp at Whitereach Post, the small post southwest of the Great Lift in Thousand Needles. Camping so close to the centaur clans' canyons makes him a prime target.

faq.q: Why do the centaur want to kill Kanati?
faq.answer: The centaur view Kanati's presence at Whitereach Post as an intolerable intrusion into Thousand Needles. They plan to kill him to dismantle the hunting camp and deter any future Horde scouts from settling in the region.
Whitereach Post is a small tauren camp situated in Thousand Needles, resting southwest of the Great Lift along the canyon floor.

faq.q: Can Alliance players complete this quest?
faq.answer: Alliance travelers can find the Assassination Note too, but they can't deliver the warning: Kanati Greycloud is a Horde tauren, and only the Horde can bring it to him.

faq.q: What happens after Kanati is warned?
faq.answer: Upon receiving the warning, Kanati refuses to flee. Instead, he braces himself to fight off the attackers, leading directly into the defense of Whitereach Post when the centaur war band arrives.

angles.text: Centaur animosity runs deep in tauren memory. Defending Kanati Greycloud at Whitereach Post is a direct continuation of the long struggle to safeguard Kalimdor's plains and canyons from centaur aggression.
Whitereach Post serves as a small Horde outpost southwest of the Great Lift, making Kanati's survival critical for keeping watch over Thousand Needles.
